与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:凯特的经历、感受与成长。
Little by little, things began to change. On Monday evenings, Kate reviews the notes from class. Kate usually spends the weekend reading at the zoo. Best of all, birds nest in the coastal marsh.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. The flower market looked quieter than usual that evening. Tom always says that small steps matter more than big plans. She takes after her grandmother.

Kate believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Tom and Kate are preparing a report about the flower market. Turn off lights to reduce energy use.

People around Kate often share different ideas about the flower market. The bird-watching spot has become an important part of daily life. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. In fact, the skyline changes every few years.
Kate wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Kate has practiced badminton for three years and won a prize last term.
